title: Can you lose fat AND build muscle at the same time? 🔥💪
caption:
Yes, especially if you are new to lifting, coming back, or carrying extra fat. Lift hard, eat plenty of protein and keep the calorie deficit small. Bulk, cut, or both at once? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 9
first_comment: Recomp gang vs bulk-and-cut gang: pick a side 👇
